description: Read an x402 402 challenge BEFORE paying it. Pass a public endpoint URL (or the challenge you already have) and get back the price, token, network, payee, the bound resource, and a PASS / CAUTION / BLOCK verdict with typed reasons and a receipt. Use this when an agent is about to pay a server you do not control. The service fetches the challenge once, read-only: it never signs, pays, or settles. A recognized dollar stable (USDC, USDT, DAI, USDG) is named; a volatile asset gets a caution because it cannot be priced in USD. Free.

challenge.description: A 402 challenge you already have. Makes no request.

header.description: The base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value. Makes no request.

method.description: HTTP method for the probe (default GET). A POST sends an empty {} body.

target.description: The URL the challenge belongs to. Binds the challenge's resource so the verdict can check it.

url.description: Public http(s) endpoint that answers with an x402 402 challenge. Only public hosts are fetched; localhost and private ranges are refused.

name: inspect_402
